🌸 A small update 🤍 
 
Thank you so much for all your responses on the story sessions ✨ 
After listening to your suggestions, we’ve decided to keep this channel purely for peaceful ambient music, sleep, and calmness 🌙 
 
And for everyone interested in soulful stories, affirmations, and reflections… we’ve created a separate little space for it 🤍🌿 
 
✨ "Soulful by Ruvi" https://www.youtube.com/@SoulfulbyRuvi 
 
Our very first story session goes live this Saturday at 7 PM 🌸 
 
These stories are inspired by real people and are simply gentle reminders of the strength and light that already exist within all of us ✨ 
 
And yes… we intentionally kept the narration human, not AI-generated 🤍 
It may have small imperfections, but we wanted it to feel like one heart speaking to another 🌷 
 
If this resonates with you, we’d truly love for you to subscribe and join us there 🌼✨
